description: Source code for a class that writes build rules for binary targets in a build system, specifically for Ninja build files. It handles dependencies, compiler/linker flags, and target-specific configurations.

classes.name: NinjaBinaryTargetWriter
classes.description: Class responsible for generating Ninja build rules for binary targets, handling dependencies, flags, and target-specific configurations.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main method to generate build rules, delegating to Rust or C binary target writers based on source types.

methods.name: WriteInputsStampOrPhonyAndGetDep
methods.description: Creates a stamp or phony build rule for target inputs and returns the dependency output file.

methods.name: GetClassifiedDeps
methods.description: Classifies target dependencies into linkable, non-linkable, framework, and swift module dependencies.

methods.name: ClassifyDependency
methods.description: Determines the category of a dependency based on its type and the target's properties.

methods.name: AddSourceSetFiles
methods.description: Adds object files from source sets, including handling of Swift and precompiled headers.

methods.name: WriteCompilerBuildLine
methods.description: Writes a build rule for compiling sources with specified tool and dependencies.

methods.name: WriteCustomLinkerFlags
methods.description: Outputs custom linker flags from target and config.

methods.name: WriteLibrarySearchPath
methods.description: Outputs library search paths for the linker.

methods.name: WriteLinkerFlags
methods.description: Outputs linker flags, including ldflags, search paths, and optional def file.

methods.name: WriteLibs
methods.description: Outputs linked libraries, handling source files and library switches.

methods.name: WriteFrameworks
methods.description: Outputs linked frameworks and weak frameworks.

methods.name: WriteSwiftModules
methods.description: Outputs Swift module files for linking.

methods.name: WritePool
methods.description: Outputs the pool assignment for the target if specified.
